claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
demo_focus: Debunks popular optical myth using astronaut observations and human eye resolving limits.

claim: Regular exercise reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease.
demo_focus: Validates robust Tier-1 medical epidemiological consensus (AHA, Lancet).

claim: Moderate coffee consumption increases the risk of heart disease.
demo_focus: Tests epistemic calibration: system hedges instead of forcing binary True/False.

claim: Global average temperature increase of 1.5C has no impact on extreme weather events.
demo_focus: Tests refutation of cherry-picked denialist climate claims using IPCC data.

claim: Global lithium ion battery production volume doubled in the past 24 months.
demo_focus: Identifies time-bound claims where industrial registry data is still being compiled.

claim: Humans only use 10% of their brains.
demo_focus: Debunks persistent pop-culture myth using modern fMRI and evolutionary metabolic evidence.

claim: Childhood vaccines cause autism spectrum disorder.
demo_focus: Verifies historical retraction of fraudulent studies and cites multi-cohort trials (CDC, WHO).

claim: Habitual knuckle cracking causes arthritis in human hand joints.
demo_focus: Explains nitrogen cavitation mechanics and cites Donald Unger clinical cohort study.

claim: Eating carrots significantly improves human night vision beyond normal acuity.
demo_focus: Traces WWII RAF radar deception campaign and separates deficiency cure from visual enhancement.

claim: Sugar intake causes acute hyperactivity and ADHD behavioral symptoms in children.
demo_focus: Uncovers double-blind placebo trials (JAMA) revealing parental expectation bias.

claim: Intermittent fasting is inherently superior to standard caloric restriction for fat loss.
demo_focus: Demonstrates nuanced synthesis: isocaloric comparison reveals equivalent fat loss (NEJM, JAMA).

claim: Higher per-capita chocolate consumption causes countries to produce more Nobel laureates.
demo_focus: Demonstrates Cross-Examiner catching Ecological Fallacy and spurious confounding variables.

claim: Cigarette smoking is a direct primary cause of human lung cancer.
demo_focus: Confirms molecular oncogenesis (TP53 mutations) and unequivocal dose-response epidemiology.
